visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Extreme low angle view from a white surface looking up at cosmetics bottles, including a black cap with a white interlaced logo; a young woman with long dark hair peeks into the frame with an inquisitive expression. (2) Close-up shot of a black eyeshadow palette containing four shimmering circular shades in cool tones; silver text overlays appear on the left and right. (3) The woman stands in a brightly lit white hallway wearing a light blue mesh long-sleeve top over a black camisole, looking directly at the camera with a neutral-to-cool expression. (4) Series of close-up shots showing the woman's hands opening an eyeshadow palette and using a small sponge applicator to apply light blue shimmer to her eyelids; her skin is fair and her eyes are focused on her reflection. (5) Close-up of her applying pink blush to her cheekbones with a round brush from a compact palette that has two shades of pink and a logo. (6) Close-up of her applying reddish-brown lipstick from a black and gold tube, followed by shots of her smiling and smacking her lips. (7) Rapid montage showing glittery star swatches on her forearm, the woman dancing in a room, and her posing outdoors at night with a clear umbrella while wearing the same outfit. (8) Final static shot of various Chanel makeup products, a brush, and a gold logo necklace arranged on a grey surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo electronic dance-pop music begins immediately with a heavy kick drum and pulsing bassline; a synthetic riser effect leads into the first musical phrase. (2) Rhythmic female group vocals enter, singing in a mix of English and Korean; the vocal delivery is high-arousal and energetic with a bright tonal quality. (3) A series of sharp, percussive 'camera shutter' sound effects are interspersed rhythmically to coincide with visual scene cuts during the makeup application. (4) The music continues with a dense arrangement of synths and processed vocal ad-libs; the tempo remains constant at approximately 128 BPM through the end of the clip, finishing with a sudden hard stop.
